summary.title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill

details: Existing autonomous research agents that go from idea to paper ship as standalone applications with their own orchestration servers and standing infrastructure, while lightweight skill-based writing tools automate only a narrow slice (no real experiment execution, no editable figures).
Long-horizon generation invites fabricated citations/numbers and claims that drift out of sync with the evidence actually measured.

Spark-to-Paper: an end-to-end research-paper generation system implemented as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant (Claude Code), with no separate agent platform; skills communicate only through persistent artifacts in a shared project directory, and a thin orchestrator fixes task order while each skill decides how to execute.

Separation of model judgment from deterministic, checkable operations (deterministic gates for citations, structure, result grounding, compilation), plus separation of experiment planning from reporting: required evidence and empty result tables are committed before results are observed, and claims are then labeled supported/partially/unsupported/contradicted and retained, weakened, moved to limitations, or removed.

Two auxiliary mechanisms: bounded recovery from a named failure mode, the Self-Refutation Loop (repeated experiment-critique-revision cycles that keep rejecting the original objective) capped at seven cycles and turned into a failure report plus a fresh idea; and role-aware figure generation where measured-data plots are produced programmatically while method diagrams are image-generated then reconstructed as editable HTML/vector PDF.
Stage 0 input routing selects Proposal Mode (unobserved results must stay unspecified) vs Data-Aware Mode (quantitative statements must be grounded in supplied data), propagated downstream.

Stages 1-7: planning (blueprint.json, template.json), citation (verified refs.bib via DOI/arXiv metadata, claims_map.json), writing, refinement, adversarial review, figure generation, assembly/compilation; conditional Stage 8 executes feasible experiments and writes measured evidence back.
Deterministic gates: Template, Blueprint, Citation, Manuscript (result integrity), Figure, Compilation; fatal violations block stage progression, warnings are logged.
Venue behavior parameterized by a template specification rather than hard-coded per venue.
Six dimensions: citation validity, fabrication detection, figure editability, review precision, cross-template robustness, generation cost (tokens/USD/wall-clock).
Eight externally selected, pre-registered topics for the full system; three shared with the single-pass baseline for paired comparison; protocol timestamped externally.

Citation validity verified post hoc with external bibliographic services (independent of in-pipeline checks); 384 references from 8 generated papers vs 320 references from 8 sampled human preprints; figure editability over ~1,900 ground-truth figure elements.
Cluster-bootstrap intervals over papers; observed range reported when only three paired runs exist.
Single-pass LLM draft with the same backbone (instrumented by the authors).
Retrospective audits of publicly released artifacts from AI Scientist, AI Scientist-v2, and Agent Laboratory (not rerun, not repriced or renormalized to the same backbone/topics).
Sampled human-written preprints as a quality reference point.
Qualitative capability comparison table against AI Scientist(-v2), AutoResearchClaw, Kosmos/Robin, Idea2Story, ARS, CycleResearcher based on public documentation.
Four configurations: single-pass draft (no gates), gates only, gates + self-review, gates + self-review + adversarial review.

Fabrication detection measured on a fixed corpus of 36 seeded probes spanning ten failure families from three sources, injected into shared source material at the same point before drafting; identical probes and detection procedure across configurations; Wilson 95% intervals.
Review precision from 60 sampled review issues judged by blinded raters (3 'cannot tell' excluded, n=57).
Token and dollar deltas measured on the three shared topics, relative to the immediately preceding configuration.

Two short-proposal-only demos (clinical risk screening; PM2.5 time-series forecasting) with two deliberately injected incorrect expectations in the proposals (Accuracy as primary metric; expectation that causal models perform comparably).

key_findings.finding: A quality-control stack of deterministic gates plus layered self-critique dramatically improves detection of unsupported claims over a single-pass draft.
key_findings.evidence: On 36 fixed injected probes, fabrication detection rises from 14% (5/36) for a single-pass draft to 69% with gates, 81% with gates + self-review, and 92% (33/36) with the full stack including adversarial review; gates contribute the largest cost increment (+8.1M tokens, +$5.3) while self-review (+1.1M, +$0.6) and adversarial review (+2.6M, +$1.6) add quality more cheaply.

key_findings.finding: End-to-end research paper generation, including experiment execution and editable vector figures, can run as skills inside an existing coding assistant with no standing infrastructure, at modest cost.
key_findings.evidence: Full-system runs on eight pre-registered topics average 11.9M tokens, $8.1, and 3.2 hours per manuscript; the capability comparison table marks Spark-to-Paper as the only listed system that is simultaneously end-to-end, runs experiments, draws figures, produces editable vectors, and requires no standing infrastructure.

key_findings.finding: Retrieval-then-verify citation handling yields citation validity above audited prior systems and even sampled human preprints.
key_findings.evidence: 99.5% of 384 references resolve (CI [98.4, 100]) versus 97.8% for 320 references in eight human preprints, 93% (42/45) for AI Scientist, 91% (58/64) for AI Scientist-v2, 96% (27/28) for Agent Laboratory, and 81% for a single-pass draft with the same backbone.

key_findings.finding: Reconstructing image-generated diagrams as code yields largely editable vector figures, a capability essentially absent in prior autonomous systems.
key_findings.evidence: 96.4% figure editability (CI [92.7, 98.6]) over ~1,900 ground-truth figure elements, versus 0% (0/210) for AI Scientist, ~3% for AI Scientist-v2, 0% (0/30) for Agent Laboratory, and 58% for sampled human preprints.

key_findings.finding: Adversarial review raises mostly genuine issues rather than spurious critiques.
key_findings.evidence: 74% precision (42/57, CI [61, 83]) on blinded-rater assessment of sampled review issues, with issues required to quote the challenged passage and survive three refutation checks (presence, already-addressed, out-of-scope).
